name: opp115_data_security_legal_bench
description: A text benchmark focused on data security and legal-domain documents designed to evaluate models' ability to classify, retrieve, and semantically match legal/security texts. It is intended for assessing embedding models and retrieval/classification pipelines on domain-specific language and information needs. Tasks typically include semantic search, classification, and information-retrieval-style evaluations.
evaluation_method: MAP / Recall@k for retrieval tasks and accuracy/F1 for classification tasks
reputation: A niche domain-specific dataset used within embedding and legal/NLP communities (appears in MTEB collections); moderate adoption for embedding evaluations.
